QUOTE: "It then calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` with its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free`" and "It is the same hook the library's own allocator uses."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer never says the buffer allocator itself requires MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY, so enabling that option alone isn't enough to route allocations through it. It only says the allocator installs its functions via the platform hook.
